# Winsights

> Winsights (also known as Winsights Markets) is a UK research and education desk for investors and traders. It explains what is moving the markets in plain English, shares daily trade and investment ideas with the reasoning behind them, and helps members learn, on WhatsApp and in a private member portal. Winsights is a trading name of Winsights Group Limited, registered in England and Wales, company number 16813424. Founder: Sharjeel Khatri. Winsights provides education and research, not personal financial advice, and is not authorised or regulated by the FCA.

## What members get
- The Winsights newsfeed: market-moving economic, central bank and geopolitical headlines on WhatsApp as they break
- An 8am morning briefing and daily FX, gold (XAU/USD) and equities trade ideas with key levels and the reasoning behind them
- The Winsights Portfolio: every position logged with its thesis and outcome, wins and losses
- Five WhatsApp desks: News, Markets, Stocks, Crypto and Chat
- A curriculum and guide library in PDF and video, beginner to advanced
- Winsights AI research assistant, an onboarding call and 1:1 learning support
- Pricing: £50 a month, £120 a quarter or £400 a year; 7-day free trial on the monthly plan

## Approach
- Not a copy-and-paste signals service; ideas are based on fundamentals, economic data and events such as geopolitics and supply shocks
- Rated 4.4 out of 5 on Trustpilot: https://uk.trustpilot.com/review/winsightsmarkets.com
